title: referral generation
subject: professional_selling
paras: Sales discipline: referral generation. Practical field technique for professional selling.

Referral generation is a crucial strategy in various industries, including sales, marketing, and customer success. In practice, businesses use referral generation to leverage their existing customer base to acquire new customers. For instance, in the software as a service (SaaS) industry, companies like Dropbox and Airbnb have successfully implemented referral programs that reward customers for inviting friends to try their services. In the healthcare industry, patient referrals are a significant source of new business for medical practices, with satisfied patients referring friends and family to their healthcare providers. In e-commerce, referral marketing platforms like ReferralCandy and LoyaltyLion help online retailers incentivize customers to refer friends in exchange for discounts or rewards. The key principle behind referral generation is to identify and motivate satisfied customers to become brand advocates, thereby increasing the reach and credibility of a business. By providing incentives, such as discounts, rewards, or exclusive content, businesses can encourage customers to share their positive experiences with others, driving word-of-mouth marketing and ultimately, new customer acquisition.
